summary: Watch my authenticated order, appointment, and account pages for changes, and tell me only when a meaningful change happens—never pollute my daily briefing with unchanged pages.
note: PER-PAGE HALF COVERED by cap-c18a0fce (implemented, local-agent/pageWatch.js); kept open for the plural, change-only form this entry asks for. GAP (1) HALF CLOSED 2026-08-07 — local-agent/originFanOut.js readOrigins() (POST /origins/read): several authenticated origins read for one question, per-origin results with provenance, evidence age and partial success. That is grouping for a one-shot read, NOT for watches: pageWatch.createWatch still takes a single url with no bundle id, no shared cadence and no joint digest, and GET /watches/reports still concatenates per-report summary strings at read time. MISSING: (1b) no watch bundles built on readOrigins; (2) "meaningful" is still literal string inequality in pageWatch.diffValues, so a re-rendered timestamp or cart count fires a report — no significance threshold, no ignore-list; (3) no voice or planner path to create a watch.
